newsitem.title: INDIA: India Tata Infotech offers 1:1 bonus shr.
newsitem.headline: India Tata Infotech offers 1:1 bonus shr.

text.p: Indian software firm Tata Infotech said on Friday it would offer investors one bonus equity share for every one share held.
The company set a dividend of 6.0 rupees a share during 1996/97 (April-March) financial year.

Tata Infotech said its net profit in 1996/97 rose to 216.0 million rupees from 200.7 million last year. The company announced a total turnover of 2.13 billion rupees against 1.76 billion in the year-ago period.
The firm said it changed its name from Tata Unisys to Tata Infotech in February this year, with the transfer of Unisys' shareholding to the Tata group.
The Tata group is India's largest industrial house.

Tata Infotech shares closed 19.0 rupees lower at 929.0 at the Bombay Stock Exchange on Friday. The stock has rocketed about 242 percent in 1997, boosted by massive buying by foreign funds and local players, with the software sector topping the shopping list of foreign funds.
